# Auto Trader (Python_Finance)
Windows + PowerShell + `uv`, Python >= 3.13. Run tests with `uv run pytest`. Demo trading only; never use real money.
Before editing code under `src/project` or `Test`, load the skills `autotrader-codebase` (layout, APIs, test patterns) and `autotrader-guardrails` (hard rules, known traps).
Keep diffs minimal; do not touch files outside the request. Reply concisely: changed files + test summary line.
